summary: Retest of iteration_13 findings + short regression. 37/37 pytest tests pass in tests/test_security_hardening.py; the file was updated for the activate-code change and gained new reports, IP-counter and panel tests. All 5 retest items are verified. (1) /api/reports/analytics, /send-report and /test-email return 401 without X-Admin-Password or with a wrong one. analytics returns 200 with the correct password through the public URL (51 users, no 500). (2) activate-code returns 401 'Connectez-vous pour activer un code' without a token or with a bad token. userId in the body is ignored. A valid token gives 200 and the subscription becomes active monthly (+30 days); reusing the code gives 400. On the frontend /subscription screen the request sends a Bearer token: a wrong code gives 404, a valid lowercase spaced code gives 200, the modal closes, the CTA changes to 'Renouveler' and the profile shows an active subscription. (3) After 4 failures from an IP, a successful login does not reset the IP counter: the next failure gives 401, then 429 for any identifier, the valid account included (checked on PIN and credential login). (4) The ambassador panel pricing table shows 5/4/1 €, 14/13/1 €, 55/50/5 €, with no undefined or NaN. (5) A failed frontend login shows the inline error and logs only console.warn; the only console 'error' is the browser's own 'Failed to load resource 401' line, not app code. Regression: PIN login, password login, ambassador login (fresh TEST ambassador), admin login and Stripe checkout all return 200; CORS and removed endpoints are OK. Exception: the webhook without a signature returns 503 'Webhook secret not configured', not 400, because STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty in backend/.env (iteration 13 saw 400, so the secret is gone).

critical.issue: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty in backend/.env, so every webhook is refused with 503 'Webhook secret not configured', not 400. This is safe (fails closed) but real Stripe events are rejected: subscription and ambassador payments will not be confirmed by webhook. Unverified: whether polling via GET /payments/stripe/session/{id} activates the subscription instead. Iteration 13 saw 400, so the secret was lost or not materialized from Secrets.

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview, React Native's Alert.alert does nothing, so the success alert 'Abonnement activé !' (and the error alert for a wrong code) never appears, and router.replace('/(tabs)/dashboard') only runs from the alert button. Web users see the modal close with no message. Works on native.

issues: The header shows the price of the currently selected plan (e.g. '$59,40 - Annuel'), even though the activation code's plan is decided by the code itself (here monthly). This can confuse users.

The pricing table now uses €, but the dashboard cards ($338 revenue, $212 commissions) and the Ventes table (`$${s.price}`, `$${s.commission}`, admin_ambassador_panel.py:442-443) still use $. Currency is inconsistent.

action_items: HIGH: Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET again (Emergent Secrets / backend/.env) and restart the backend. A webhook without a signature should then return 400, not 503.

LOW: In subscription.tsx, show web-visible feedback on activation success or error (e.g. window.alert or inline message on Platform.OS==='web') and navigate to the dashboard without depending on the alert button.
LOW: Use € consistently in the ambassador panel dashboard cards and the Ventes table (admin_ambassador_panel.py:442-443).
critical_code_review_comments: ambassador_api.py:664 'if not user_id' is now dead code (already 401 above); the 400 message 'ID utilisateur et code requis' should only mention the code.
reporting.py still has fallback defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME (os.getenv(..., 'mongodb://localhost:27017')); env-only config is preferred.
Frontend login-failure handling OK: LoginScreen/apiService use console.warn; ambassador/index.tsx keeps console.error only for network/non-JSON errors (acceptable).
